headline: 8 Michigan deals, $27.9M raised — led by Mudita Venture Fund Qp LLC

top_deals.summary: Mudita Venture Fund Qp LLC, a Bingham Farms-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $15.7M raise; $15.7M sold to 38 investors.
Sharrow Engineering, Inc., a Harper Woods-based manufacturing company, filed a $15M debt and options/warrants offering under Rule 506(b); $11.6M sold to 14 investors. (Amended filing.)

top_deals.company: Twin Capital Partners Fund I, LLC
top_deals.summary: Twin Capital Partners Fund I, LLC, a Livonia-based real estate company, filed a $10M equity and pooled fund interests offering under Rule 506(c); $0 sold.
Dataisource Inc., a Washington Township-based technology company, filed a $2M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $500K sold to 1 investor.
Equipmate, Inc, an Okemos-based computers company, filed an indefinite-size options/warrants and security to be acquired offering under Rule 506(b); $66K sold to 5 investors.

new_funds.summary: Mudita Venture Fund Qp LLC, a Bingham Farms-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $15.7M raise; $15.7M sold to 38 investors.

new_funds.company: Bloomfield Capital Income Fund V, LLC - Series E
new_funds.summary: Bloomfield Capital Income Fund V, LLC - Series E, a Birmingham-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $0 sold.

notable_ma.summary: Mat Ishbia and others reported a 79.7% stake in UWM Holdings Corporation (UWMC) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 15).

material_agreements.summary: Gentherm Inc (THRM) entered into a material definitive agreement (credit facility).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $27.9M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, down 47% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Sharrow Engineering, Inc. (Harper Woods, Manufacturing) targeting $15M. Good question to ask: are founders in manufacturing & automotive favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $15.7M raised so far — led by Mudita Venture Fund Qp LLC (Venture Capital Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?

Mat Ishbia and others reported a 79.7% stake in UWM Holdings Corporation (UWMC) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 15). Schedule 13D filers can push for strategic change, so it's worth asking whether shareholders see a sale or restructuring on the table.
